about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.undefined-by-ibm: only non-digit data in a numeric USAGE DISPLAY item kills it, and IBM documents no result for that
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

survivors.before: private final Field f105_PROC_TRAN_DESC = Field.alphanumeric(s_PROCTRAN_AREA, 47, 40, false);
survivors.after: private final Field f105_PROC_TRAN_DESC = Field.alphanumeric(s_PROCTRAN_AREA, 47, 41, false);
survivors.reason: field_observability: truncated: PROC-TRAN-DESC is only ever moved whole into alphanumeric items of at most 40 bytes, so its 40 or 41 bytes give them the same leading bytes (solver-unobservable)

survivors.before: private final Field f278_EIBTRMID = Field.alphanumeric(s_DFHEIBLK, 16, 4, false);
survivors.after: private final Field f278_EIBTRMID = Field.alphanumeric(s_DFHEIBLK, 16, 5, false);
survivors.reason: field_observability: dead window: no reachable statement or runtime reader reads EIBTRMID or bytes 16-20 of DFHEIBLK (solver-unobservable)
every read of s_DB2_DATE_REFORMAT's items follows a top-level Cobol.store in its own method; initial image is never read (inert-image)
every read of s_ACCOUNT_CONTROL's items follows a top-level Cobol.store in its own method; initial image is never read (inert-image)

survivors.before: Cobol.store(f274_EIBTIME, BigDecimal.valueOf(now.getHour() * 10000L + now.getMinute() * 100L + now.getSecond()), false, CS);
survivors.after: Cobol.store(f274_EIBTIME, BigDecimal.valueOf(now.getHour() * 10000L - now.getMinute() * 100L + now.getSecond()), false, CS);
survivors.reason: f274_EIBTIME is only stored into and no read EIB item shares its bytes: the stored value is never seen (eib-resp-unread)
